summary: The candidate quickly diagnosed the symptom (shipped units reappearing in stock) from the test diff, made a single edit to sweep.ts, and confirmed the suite passed before ending the session. The session was very short, with minimal narration of the actual fix and no post-fix reflection on why it worked.

dimensions.analysis: The candidate opened the failing test and paraphrased the diff (shipped units returning), which is useful groundwork, but never posed a question about whether partially-shipped holds should retain their shipped-unit deduction before diving into the sweep code. They moved straight from reading the diff to editing without checking the assumption against the test's intent.

The stated plan at the point of committing to a direction was to 'dig around' the release path and watch hold-state fields — a location and vague intent, not a mechanism. Despite the earlier diagnostic remark hinting at the right symptom, no explicit hypothesis like 'sweep releases original count instead of remaining' was voiced before editing.

The candidate narrated the failure diff and a loose plan to investigate the sweep and hold-state fields, giving an interviewer a rough sense of direction. However, no narration accompanied the actual edit or the reasoning behind the specific code change, leaving a gap in the transcript's explanatory power.

A single, targeted edit was made to src/sweep.ts and saved, consistent with the stated (if vague) intent to work in the release path, with no thrashing or contradictory changes observed. The execution was efficient and resulted in a passing suite, though the sparse planning makes it hard to judge precision against a stated mechanism.

The candidate re-ran the test suite after the edit and confirmed a pass before ending the session, meeting the baseline expectation of checking work rather than declaring success blindly. There is no evidence of deeper edge-case checking (e.g. confirming full-release holds still behave correctly) beyond the aggregate suite result.

Immediately after the suite passed, the candidate ended the session with no stated explanation of why the original fix addressed the phantom-stock mechanism or how it relates to the remaining-vs-original count issue. The session ends without any articulation connecting the fix to the root cause.
